title: Lycidas
summary: Raleigh names Lycidas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Lycidas, also called Cyrcilus by Demosthenes, who aduised the Senate to accept the conditions of Mardonius, and was stoned to death. The two names were left as one man. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VI, §. VIII, sig. 416a–416b
